Final round-3 COMBINED review carrying the criteria, design and consistency briefs. Reviewed ONLY frozen target tree 50d5b30b4895fb3f997b793240b19e3193e5537d -> 15d0e4efcfd20c9d8159cc3cd06d8e0ba5de41a0, plus corresponding authored evidence/decision writebacks at launchpad tree 4cd59ba00638176731792cfed589ab819b98170f -> a82181ea636197a529657195567c205976b41451. The current binding is reviews/round-3-candidate.json, captured 2026-11-05T09:04:45.640Z. It names target merge base/head 55b59c9133056c1d6471274a9676a7d5649196ac and launchpad merge base/head a5e7076cfe1082d888966223f544e17d471324ae; these are not substituted for the round-2 since-tree boundary. The manifest sits outside its own captured launchpad tree. Both cwd/Git roots were confirmed before Git, and both repositories stayed read-only.

The complete target since-tree diff contains only arrive.presentation.ts and collision-avoidance.presentation.ts: 9 insertions and 12 deletions. I read both full frozen current presenters, their full simulation producers and model entry points, and their full existing model specs. The direct presenter-import search under libs/features/tools/src resolves to the two read model entry points. No whole-migration review was reopened. The two changed presenter SHA-256 identities are c0180cea29d5e0ffcdb4ce7f295c70fb717a043ccd74d98ee9610d60180de4e7 (Arrive) and e87d528b3baad6e9aaf22182ee74e963d858e4fb81f7077e63cd9fe40972623f (Collision avoidance).

Criteria: no concrete acceptance failure, regression of main behavior or missing necessary behavior regression was found in this delta. Arrive model supplies arriveSamples(example) once to present. Each sample retains calculateArriveStep for the same pre-step state, and its desired field is exactly desiredVelocity(state.position, example) with the default main radius. The changed frame vector/readout and main timeline therefore read the previously recomputed value. lateBraking receives the identical main state sequence; its equal-radius arm shares that sequence, while its distinct-radius arm still calls arriveFrames(example, example.lateRadius), whose unchanged adapter maps the same arriveSamples states. Existing specs explicitly cover distinct-radius overshoot, equal-radius comparison narration, return past the target, chart bounds and displayed desired values. Collision's samples retain closestApproach(state) in calculation.prediction for each displayed state. The changed predictions array now reads those same results; its timeline separation series and cleared/passed moment selectors retain their predicates. Existing specs cover concrete prediction numbers, equal velocities, past/safe/horizon cases, head-on failure, text-equivalent values, timeline lengths and deterministic presentation. I read these tests and did not execute them.

Design: the delta removes the specific duplicate main Arrive simulation and desired-velocity reads, and the duplicate Collision prediction map identified in the carried round-2 notes. The retained values stay attached to their own sampled state and there is no new abstraction, mutable presentation ownership or parameter change. Distinct counterfactual runs remain distinct. I make no universal claim that every calculation in the corpus is evaluated only once, and propose no further optimization sweep.

Consistency: the only product source changes are the two presenters, so no mechanism, catalog, message, fixture, expected-output, schema, dependency or version consumer changes in this since-tree delta. package.json and package-lock.json retain identical frozen blob identities. I read the launchpad writeback diffs for repair README, fan-out, review README, D049/D050 and the generated decision-index rows, and the newly filed round-2 reports. The index rows match D049/D050; the README's 176-case and bundle claims match their receipts. D004/D033/D050 record the prior budget authority and scoped extension, keeping the worker/dispatch bounds; no raw ignored operator capture or private control record was opened. The round-1 reports and round-2 criteria/design reports were read as carried prior judgments, not independently re-adjudicated. Rechecks is intentionally empty for this since-tree review.

Parent evidence: round-3-validation.json records executed exit-zero lint, temporary complete-output comparison and check:bundle selections. It reports foundation type/tooling coverage through lint, 406485 initial bytes and no lazy feature code in the initial closure. comparison/round-3-results.json reports all 40 movement models/176 default and individual offered minimum/maximum cases matched the unchanged round-1 capture at tree 598d4b63c2d3f076a15777c103010956016b5872, with zero differences and 53530746 normalized bytes per arm. I read the retained comparison program: it preserves arrays and values while sorting object keys and compares the complete normalized serialized result. I statically matched all 163 source-hash entries to frozen target blobs with zero mismatches, verified the retained probe hash, and compared all 176 case/digest/byte rows with final-results.json: they are identical. Nine read writeback/evidence paths also match both the current manifest hashes and frozen launchpad blobs. These were static identity/data checks, not product execution. Earlier review-fix-validation.json records Tools 105 files/962 cases and 161 browser cases before round 2; those dated receipts are not passing future complete-gate rows.

Reading boundary: filesRead names content reads, selected authority sections/diffs and the two package identity checks; the other 155 source blobs in the 163-entry comparison inventory were read only for SHA-256 identity, not semantic source review. Manifest path arrays were inventoried, not read line by line as product code. The first oversized multi-file outputs were truncated, so the required final-round rules, authority sections, report findings/reports, current presenters, producer/consumer source and delta evidence were subsequently read in bounded outputs. I did not inspect raw comparison captures or native logs, recompute physics/stream outputs, exercise combined input variations beyond the retained cases, measure latency, render screenshots, reopen public references or read docs/control/local. No test, probe, gate, browser, repository edit, background task or descendant was launched. Criterion 1 remains the verifier-owned walkthrough; complete plain/review target gates and the final document gate remain parent lifecycle work after this last review. Their later-phase status is not a finding.

This worker's token total, usage source, scope and cutoff are unknown; no effective readback or usage counter is invented. Parent remains sole writer. Only scratch/round-3-combined.json was written.
